mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sys_role_assignment (id, employee_id, role_id, scope_type, scope_value, status, created_at) SELECT #{assignmentId}, #{employeeId}, r.id, 'SELF', #{scopeValue}, 'ACTIVE', #{createdAt} FROM sys_role r WHERE r.role_code = 'EMPLOYEE' AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM sys_role_assignment a WHERE a.employee_id = #{employeeId} AND a.role_id = r.id )
mapper.update: UPDATE sys_employee AS e SET employment_status = 'RESIGNED', account_status = 'DISABLED', updated_at = #{syncedAt}, version = version + 1 WHERE e.employment_status = 'ACTIVE' AND e.source_type = 'EHR' AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM sys_ehr_employee_stage s WHERE s.run_id = #{runId} AND s.ehr_person_id = e.ehr_person_id )
